_comment: The Slag Furnace (#236), built out of the Cupola the way the Cupola was built out of the Burn
Barrel: each smelter is the last one plus what it needed to do more. That chain is deliberate -
you cannot own this without having owned a Cupola, which is the machine that makes the slag it
eats, so the two arrive in the only order that makes sense.
Steel rather than copper for the shell. A cupola remelts iron at around 1500C; vitrifying silicates
runs hotter still, and copper melts at 1085C - the Copper Pipe that plumbs the Cupola would not
Cost belongs to the balance pass (#36); the shape belongs here.
